notes: Host-side verifier reads the final dws_doc_cli state and scores PO exception triage: per-exception triage reports (named, severity-classified, placed in the right folder, filled) plus a comment on each exception PO, restraint on the 24 normal POs and the distractors, an unmodified template, and a PO Exception Summary with correct counts. Capacity checks are folded capability units (per docs/check-granularity.md); the 8 exception_triaged checks are kept per-PO (R3a) because exception identification + severity classification across all 8 is the hard core competency; each folds that PO's underlying triage-doc + comment atoms by AND.
